raw_segments.text: Filia's fog, then, had won the twenty thousand pounds, but, as he had spent nearly nineteen
thousand on the way, the pecuniary gain was small.
His object was, however, to be victorious, and not to win money.
He divided the one thousand pounds that remained between Passapartout and the unfortunate fix,
against whom he cherished no grudge.
He deducted, however, from Passapartouts, share the cost of the gas which had burned
in his room for nineteen hundred and twenty hours, for the sake of regularity.
